title: Binance to Hyperliquid price discovery
claim: A causally earlier Binance innovation predicts a subsequent executable Hyperliquid price response after clock and cost controls.
mechanism: Liquidity and information fragment across venues, causing temporary leadership and delayed adjustment.
target: Subsequent Hyperliquid mid-price or executable return
primaryBaseline: Contemporaneous no-lead model and target-venue-only dynamics

evidence.summary: Synchronized cross-venue capture has not started and therefore has no eligibility date.

nextAction: Implement synchronized event capture and accumulate 90 quality-valid days before evaluation.
